dish.title: Aloo Paratha with Cilantro-Mint Chutney and Kachumber Salad

recipe_version.title: Aloo Paratha with Cilantro-Mint Chutney and Kachumber Salad
recipe_version.description: Whole-wheat flatbreads stuffed with a spiced potato filling of green chile, ginger, cumin, amchur, and cilantro, rolled thin and cooked on a hot cast-iron pan with oil until blistered and crisp-flecked. Served with a bright cilantro-mint chutney and a cucumber, tomato, and onion kachumber.

ingredients.name: green chiles
ingredients.preparation: 2 minced for the filling, 1 for the chutney

ingredients.name: cilantro
ingredients.preparation: 1/2 cup chopped for the filling, 1 1/2 cups loosely packed for the chutney

ingredients.name: cumin seeds
ingredients.preparation: toasted in a dry pan and crushed

ingredients.name: lemons
ingredients.note: juiced, about 1/4 cup; half for the chutney, half for the salad

ingredients.name: neutral oil
ingredients.note: 1 tbsp dough, about 5 tbsp for brushing on the pan

ingredients.name: kosher salt
ingredients.note: 1 tsp dough, 1 tsp potato water, 3/4 tsp filling, 1/4 tsp chutney and salad

steps.title: Make the dough and prep
steps.body: In a large bowl mix the 3 cups flour with 1 tsp salt and 1 tbsp oil, then add the 1 1/4 cups water gradually, kneading into a soft, smooth dough, about 8 minutes. Cover and let it rest. Peel and chunk the potatoes, mince 2 chiles, grate the ginger, chop 1/2 cup cilantro, and juice the lemons. Toast and crush the cumin seeds.

steps.title: Boil the potatoes
steps.body: Put the potatoes in a 4-quart pot with 8 cups cold water and 1 tsp salt. Bring to a boil over high and cook until fork-tender, about 20 minutes total. The dough rests during the boil (overlap stated).

steps.title: Make the chutney and salad
steps.body: While the potatoes boil, blend the remaining cilantro, the mint, the remaining chile, half the lemon juice, 3 tbsp water, and a pinch of salt until smooth. Toss the cucumber, tomatoes, and red onion with the rest of the lemon juice and a pinch of salt. Runs inside step 2 (overlap stated).

steps.title: Make the filling
steps.body: Drain the potatoes well and return them to the warm pot for 1 minute to steam dry. Mash until completely smooth with no lumps, then mix in the minced chiles, ginger, chopped cilantro, cumin, amchur, garam masala, and 3/4 tsp salt. Spread on a plate to cool and divide into 8 portions.

steps.title: Roll and cook the parathas
steps.body: Heat the cast-iron pan over medium-high. Divide the dough into 8 balls. Flatten one into a 4-inch round, set a filling portion in the center, gather the edges up and pinch to seal, then flatten and roll gently on a floured board into a 7-inch round. Cook on the dry pan 1 minute until spotted, flip, brush the top with oil, flip again and press with a spatula until golden and puffed, about 1 minute per side more. Roll the next paratha while each one cooks; keep finished breads wrapped in a towel.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Serve the parathas hot, cut in halves or quarters, with the chutney and kachumber alongside.

near_duplicate_review: Compared with coconut-chickpea-curry, saag-paneer, and vegetable-biryani-cashews: no curry or rice, the bread is the dish. Compared with turkish-lahmacun: stuffed and sealed bread, not a topped flatbread; no meat. Compared with the arepas in this wave: wheat dough, stuffed before cooking, different spice profile.
